name: reads-shared-system
prompt: Refresh a project under an existing shared Company Kernel system.
must: read the shared system and only relevant lenses
keep system judgment separate from project truth

name: small-useful-set
prompt: Initialize context for a fast-moving B2B startup.
must: create PROJECT.md and fast-changing NOW state
create only files justified by the work
state current entry and larger trajectory
must_not: create one file per business department

name: coherence-over-cheap-feature
prompt: A useful analytics module is cheap to build but creates a second product mental model.
must: judge whether it strengthens the core loop
must_not: recommend it merely because implementation is cheap

name: truth-debt
prompt: The product stopped serving agencies and now sells directly to facilities.
must: rewrite stale audience and market truth
must_not: append the new audience beneath the old one

name: non-startup
must: adapt ambition to adoption interoperability and ecosystem leverage
avoid forced buyer and pipeline language
must_not: create empty GTM or economics files
